core_change_needed: Add a Level Selector so simulation can run at grid, plant, hub or block level.

data_filter_logic.grid: Filter children where parent rolls up to GRID_PAVAGADA_220KV; aggregate all plant/hub/block values.
data_filter_logic.plant: Filter by plant_id = SOL_PAVAGADA; aggregate all hubs/blocks.
data_filter_logic.hub: Filter blocks where parent_hub_id = selected hub_id.

chart_logic.actual_mw: Sum actual_mw for all selected child assets, or direct value for block.
chart_logic.possible_power_mw: Sum possible_power_mw for selected child assets.
chart_logic.scheduled_mw: Sum schedule for selected child assets.
chart_logic.local_limit_mw: For grid/plant/hub, use active limiting constraint if present; otherwise capacity-level limit. For block, use direct local limit.
chart_logic.forecast_p10_mw: Do not simply sum P10. Use correlation-aware approximation: sum(P50) - sqrt(sum((P50-P10)^2)) for children.
chart_logic.forecast_p90_mw: Do not simply sum P90. Use correlation-aware approximation: sum(P50) + sqrt(sum((P90-P50)^2)) for children.

ui_behavior: When user selects horizon, show technique card from model_selection_by_asset_horizon.csv.
When user selects hub, show hub-specific model, sensors and child block contribution.
When user selects block, show direct SCADA/sensor model and inverter/sensor diagnostics.
When user selects grid/plant, show aggregate forecast plus contribution breakdown by hub.

recommended_tabs.plant_brief: Show available horizons and default model family at plant/hub/block level in a Forecast Configuration mini-section.
recommended_tabs.historical_lab: Show which model technique was validated for each horizon and level, with metrics.
recommended_tabs.live_operating_day: Main place to switch grid/plant/hub/block level and see simulation at that level.
recommended_tabs.online_learning: Show horizon-wise learning and refresh recommendation for the selected level.
